_note: THE PURCHASE SIDE OF A SOFA WHOSE SALES SIDE IS ALREADY RULED, 2026-09-09. Every build in sofa-compartment-corrections-drawings.json names ONE document and it is always the SALES order, so the sales order got its compartments and the purchase order raised from it was left holding the single lead piece the importer created. Measured on production, read-only run 34299650607 (probe-so-po-compartment-cover.mjs, book cut 2026-09-09T00:18:49Z): thirteen purchase orders carry FEWER compartments than the sales order they were raised from, and that is the whole of the `transfer to` / `transfer from` difference on those documents - the reconcile compares the FRACTION transferred (lib/transfer-counter-verdict.mjs), so a sales order of three compartments with one purchased row reads 1/3 against the book's 1/1. THE OWNER'S RULE DECIDES WHICH SIDE MOVES: 「Purchase order follows the SALES ORDER」, given on 2026-09-09 about HC-SO-010287 itself, the mirrored pair in this file. So the sales build is copied ONTO the purchase order, never the other way. WHY EVERY ENTRY IS KEYED AND NONE IS TEXT-MATCHED: the applier finds a build by scm.purchase_order_items.description2, and the plan run 34297962031 skipped eleven purchase orders with `no line carries this text` while the ACCOUNT BOOK's text for those same lines matches the needle exactly - the ERP's purchase row holds different text from the book's. The book's own DtlKey does not have that problem: every purchase row concerned carries it in linked_ac_dtlkey (printed as `key NNNNNN` by that probe), and lib/sofa-desc2-match.mjs treats a line key as IDENTITY and never falls back to text. WHAT IS NOT IN THIS FILE, and why: HC-PO-008783 (its console is an open question the owner alone can close - see the _held entry in the 2026-09 file) and HC-PO-009828 (no line key at all; backfill-ac-downstream-line-keys.mjs is what fills that, not a ruling).
_rules: Same as every other round: money never moves - the price rides the FIRST piece and every other piece is 0; rows are matched to target pieces and UPDATED in place so a row id and any receipt hanging off it survives. RECEIVED PURCHASE ORDERS ARE NOT WAVED THROUGH HERE. Five of these thirteen are RECEIVED, and 「库存先不看」 means a write that would move an on-hand figure stops. It is not this file that decides that: apply-sofa-compartment-corrections.mjs already refuses a build whose downstream moved real stock (downstreamMovedStock - any scm.inventory_movements row naming the document, or a GRN/DO that is not migrated_no_stock), and it PRINTS the figure it refused on. The entries are written so the plan run answers that question with a measurement instead of an argument; a refusal is the answer, and the document stays named.
